modules.title: 真实消息和文件怎样占满一次回答的空间
上下文窗口的空间怎样被分配

items.title: 共享空间
items.text: 系统提示词、对话历史、文件和预留的回答空间共同共享同一个上下文窗口的总限额。

items.title: 输入与输出限制不同
items.text: 输入上下文和最大输出 Token 数是分开的（回答被截断通常是因为输出达到上限，不一定是窗口满了）。

items.title: 更大不代表更好
items.text: 窗口更大不意味着可以随意塞入资料——无关内容会稀释 AI 的注意力，导致偏离重点。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 窗口更大不代表该把所有资料都塞进去；无关内容也会分散重点。

lessonPractice.title: Agent 开始遗漏刚补充的要求，回答也常在结尾被截断。准备继续同一任务前，先怎么处理？

options.label: 梳理当前任务必需的规则、资料和近期决定，摘要旧内容并预留回答空间
options.feedback: 对。上下文要优先保留当前任务需要的信息；旧内容可浓缩，但仍要给回答留出空间。

options.label: 保留所有输入，把给回答预留的空间压到最小
options.feedback: 输入都放进去却没有足够输出空间，模型仍可能无法完成回答。

options.label: 再发一条消息，把剩余资料继续贴进去
options.feedback: 新消息也会占用上下文。没有先筛掉无关内容，只会让空间更紧张。

en.title: An Agent starts missing newly added requirements and replies often cut off. Before continuing the same task, what should you do first?

options.label: Identify the rules, material, and recent decisions the task needs, summarize older content, and reserve answer space
options.feedback: Correct. Prioritize material the current task needs, compress older content, and leave room for a response.

options.label: Keep every input and reduce the response reserve as much as possible
options.feedback: Without enough response space, the model may still be unable to complete the answer.

options.label: Send another message and paste the remaining material there
options.feedback: The new message also consumes context. Adding more without removing noise makes the limit worse.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 继续这个任务前，请先列出当前必须保留的规则、文件和最近决定，并把较早内容压缩成一段可继续工作的摘要。先把这份摘要和建议排除的材料给我确认，再基于它继续，不要假设你能删除当前对话。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Before continuing this task, list the rules, files, and recent decisions that must remain, then compress older material into a short working brief. Show me that brief and the material you recommend excluding for confirmation before proceeding; do not assume you can delete the current conversation.

learning.assumes: You have pasted long text, uploaded files, or asked several follow-up questions.
learning.outcome: You can identify which messages and files use space in a request’s context window.

modules.title: What fills the space for one answer?
How context window space is allocated

items.title: Shared space
items.text: System prompts, conversation history, files, and response space all share the same total context window limit.

items.title: Output truncation is separate
items.text: Input context and max output tokens are separate (output truncation is usually due to reaching the output limit, not necessarily a full window).

items.title: Bigger isn't always better
items.text: A larger window doesn't mean you can cram everything in—irrelevant material dilutes the AI's attention and causes it to drift.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A larger window does not mean you should include every file. Irrelevant material can bury the point.
